summary: Beta Bionics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a follow-on equity offering of 7,652,175 common shares plus pre-funded warrants for 1,043,484 shares, priced at $17.25 per share (warrants at $17.2499, exercise price $0.0001), for gross proceeds of about $150.0 million before $9.0 million underwriting discounts. Underwriters J.P. Morgan, Piper Sandler, Wells Fargo and Leerink hold a 30-day option for 1,304,348 additional shares. Net proceeds are roughly $141.0 million. Nasdaq ticker BBNX closed at $19.23 on September 15, 2026, delivery expected September 17, 2026. This is a routine primary shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and the warrant overhang.
